note: Tiny family-run campground by Curtis Creek between Banner Elk and Elk Park at ~3,500 ft, near Grandfather Mountain, Elk River Falls and Tweetsie Railroad; very large sites with concrete patios, plus one efficiency cabin. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 30/50-amp full hookups, Wi-Fi and coin laundry on the operator's site; added no bathhouse (showers/flush toilets false: 'Full hookups units only due to no bathroom facilities'). Note cleaned of hookup/amenity text. Not stated: site count (4, derived, left), season, price ('Contact us for rates'), booking method beyond phone/email.
flags: No posted price: 'We have nightly and weekly rates. Contact us for rates.' (https://thelittlecampground.com/services). No booking engine, so long-stay test 2 fails on the posted-price half and the entry has no fees for the US$50 gate. Presence is otherwise fine: own website with phone, Google Maps 4.8 over 61 reviews.
